{{Quote|But, can you believe this lightsaber didn’t even come with a blade-length adjuster? I guess that’s okay if you don’t wind up, say, running for your life from fanatical followers of the Church of the First Frequency….|Anakin Skywalker, talking about Halagad Ventor's lightsaber |<ref name="SkyeWalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
A '''blade-length adjuster''' was a common [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] component. It allowed the lightsaber to adjust the length of the weapon's blade.<ref name="RPG-Core" /> When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] engaged in a [[Concordance of Fealty]] with [[Halagad Ventor]], he pointed out how Ventor's lightsaber lacked a blade-length adjustor.<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />
